description: Per paycheck net pay after federal income tax, FICA (Social Security capped at 184500 of wages, Medicare, and the additional Medicare tax), a flat state tax rate, and pretax deductions. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive paycheck calculator.

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), or hoh (head of household).

pay_frequency.description: Paychecks per year: 52 weekly, 26 biweekly, 24 semimonthly, or 12 monthly; default 26.

pretax_deductions.description: Annual pretax deductions in USD; default 0.

state_tax_rate_pct.description: Flat state tax rate percent, applied to the full salary as on the page.

name: calculate_paycheck
